meta.title: Crew
meta.description: The crew as a DSH plugin: sidebar entry, panel for crews, roles, default and project, the routes /api/pmh/crew, and the host wiring of adapter, tools and booking. Stored per account in PostgreSQL, with the file as fallback. English first, German second.

crew.title: Crew
crew.error: The crew could not be read.
crew.noCrews: No crew yet. A crew is a set of roles — each bound to a model.
crew.manageHint: Duplicate and remove change the draft — Save writes it.
crew.crewIdHint: It appears as the model name.
crew.standardHint: This crew appears first in the model picker.
crew.projectHint: Absolute path. Empty means: no project.
crew.activeHint: Off means: stored, but not offered as a model.
crew.planEmpty: No plan yet. The crew tools write it.
crew.fileModeHint: The crews live in a file and are only read here. To edit: the file by hand, or set DATABASE_URL.
crew.conflict: This identifier already belongs to another account.
